meta.name: Dressrosa
meta.description: La alianza con Law los lleva a Dressrosa para derrocar el exitoso negocio de Doflamingo. Pero el lunático Shichibukai y autoproclamado gobernante de Dressrosa tiene el control sobre todos y todo.

videos.title: Arriving at Dressrosa! The Country of Passion, Love, and Toys!
videos.overview: Dressrosa! The Straw Hats split up and set about their business on this passionate, enchanting island! But here, in the heart of enemy territory, danger lurks around every corner. Luffy’s group encounters an intriguing blind man whose luck has run dry.

videos.title: Corrida Colosseum! The Great Tournament
videos.overview: Zoro and co. strike off in search of the thieving fairy who has taken Zoro's sword, but Sanji gets distracted by the alluring dancing of a gorgeous Dressrosan. Meanwhile, the prize of the late Ace’s devil fruit draws Luffy and Franky to the colosseum.

videos.title: The Colosseum of Many New Faces and Maynard the Pursuer!
videos.overview: Luffy enters the tournament at Corrida Colosseum to compete for Ace's fruit, but with the mightiest warriors of the New World assembled and standing in his way, the competition will not be easy. The first stage of the competition is a battle royal!

videos.title: Bellamy's Changed Motivations and B Block's Start!
videos.overview: When Block A concludes, the crowds are shocked to discover the secret identity of the winner. Block B commences, and the widely despised Bartolomeo takes the ring, but he will have to contend with Dressrosa's own local favorite, Bellamy!

videos.title: B Block on Fire! Outlandish Competitors and King Punch!
videos.overview: The battle in Block B hits a crescendo as the Fighting King Elizabello II prepares his devastating King Punch! But as the powerful attack becomes imminent, the Kingdom of Prodence faction unravels!

videos.title: To Green Bit! The Adventure in the Land of Dwarves!
videos.overview: The Caesar Transfer Team is on approach to Green Bit, but the colossal coastal fish of Dressrosa are biting, and the connecting bridge has collapsed! The team gathers their wits to make it across, but they soon discover they are not alone on the island.

videos.title: Doflamingo Arrives! The Ultimate Schemer!
videos.overview: All but done for, Sanji is trapped by Violet and her crew when she suddenly changes her mind and mysteriously turns on her own men! Sanji gets in touch with Law to share a shocking secret that could unsettle all their plans in Dressrosa.

videos.title: Closely Contested Block C! Lucy and Ucy!
videos.overview: The Sunny is mysteriously deformed by Giolla’s strange powers! Meanwhile, the battle for Block C is under way, but Luffy suffers a staggering setback. He eventually knocks down the giant Hajrudin, but Chinjao has his sights set on Garp’s grandson!

videos.title: C Block's Blazing Battle and the Forgotten of Dressrosa!
videos.overview: In the colosseum, Chinjao finally faces Luffy and reveals the old grudge he bears against Garp! Meanwhile, Usopp and Robin get swept up in the Tontattas' raid against the royal family, and Franky learns the eerie secret of Dressrosa’s living toys.

videos.title: The Tontatta Rebellion and the C Block Finale!
videos.overview: The Tontattas gear up for their all-out assault on the Doflamingo Family, and Usopp and Robin are caught up in the war effort! Meanwhile, Luffy concludes his earth-shattering fight to the death with Don Chinjao.

videos.title: A Sad Past! Rebecca and Soldier-san
videos.overview: A voice from the past unsettles Luffy and sends him into a rage! Also, it's discovered that Rebecca's eternal bond with the one-legged toy soldier is linked to the violent overthrow of the old regime, perpetrated by none other than Doflamingo!

videos.title: D Block's Fiery Start and the Heavenly Demon's Revelation!
videos.overview: As Rebecca enters the ring for the battle for Block D, the crowd shows its contempt for her heritage and vicious contenders set their sights on her. Meanwhile, Law is pinned by Fujitora, and Doflamingo has the upper hand.

videos.title: Law's New Strategy and the Colosseum's Underground Nightmare!
videos.overview: Law must put himself in harm's way to defend the Sunny and the Straw Hats from Doflamingo's all-out assault. Meanwhile, Bartolomeo searches the colosseum for Luffy and discovers something strange about the medical center for the defeated.

videos.title: The Plight of the Riku Clan! The Lurking Hero Awaits in the Shadows!
videos.overview: The losers of the colosseum who are being held below the infirmary have an unexpected addition to their numbers. Meanwhile, the history of Tontatta is made clear, as is the shocking identity of the toy soldier!

videos.title: Doflamingo's Relentless Pursuit
videos.overview: Revealed is the sad fate of King Riku, his army, and his daughter, Princess Viola, as well as how the people of Dressrosa fell into the hands of Doflamingo. Not to mention, all the toys in the country share a mysterious secret.

videos.title: SOP Strategy
videos.overview: Zoro and Kin'emon make a mad dash to save Law, but Admiral Fujitora stands in their way, bringing his full power against them. The toy soldier lays out the plan to liberate the Tontattas and bring down the Doflamingo Family: Operation SOP.

videos.title: The Underground World
videos.overview: Usopp and Robin travel via an underground tunnel dug by the tiny people of the Tontatta Tribe. On the surface, Franky makes his way to the Toys House to cause a distraction to help his crewmates, but standing in his way is quite the guy!

videos.title: Fujitora's Outlook
videos.overview: Viola, once a princess of the Dressrosan royal family, shows Luffy and the others a secret entrance into the palace. In the meantime, Admiral Fujitora reveals his audacious plans for the Seven Warlords of the Sea!

videos.title: Diamante and Pica
videos.overview: The final round at Corrida Colosseum kicks off, and Diamante joins the combatants in an all-out struggle to win the prize! Meanwhile, Luffy and co., en route to Doflamingo, are faced with an immovable member of the Donquixote Family.

videos.title: Captain
videos.overview: With Operation SOP in its final stage, the Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander’s stunning true identity.

videos.title: Usoland the Liar
videos.overview: With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make.

videos.title: Dressrosa in Turmoil
videos.overview: Usopp creates a miracle! Toys across Dressrosa regain their true forms, a flood of lost memories return, and a forgotten hero launches a long overdue attack on the villainous tyrant Doflamingo!

videos.title: Bird Cage
videos.overview: Sabo makes a risky move to end the championship battle, and Luffy hurries to free Law. Doflamingo's apparent defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but he may have a trick or two left up his sleeve.

videos.title: Executive Officer Pica
videos.overview: Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game with the highest bounty reserved for… Usopp! As Luffy and co. head toward the palace, Fujitora stands in their way, and Pica emerges in town to change the stakes of the game.

videos.title: Onward!! Army of Rogues
videos.overview: The game is afoot, and Luffy finds that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! Strangely, an argument breaks out to decide who gets the honor of taking down Doflamingo once and for all!

videos.title: The State of the War
videos.overview: Law's reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed! Luffy heads toward Doflamingo's refuge, making his way through the guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who is now armed with a familiar fiery power!

videos.title: Battle
videos.overview: Heavy hitters from the colosseum turn from wringing each other's necks toward a unified plan, which might be just enough to give Luffy the chance he needs to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo.

videos.title: A Man's World
videos.overview: Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along! Meanwhile, the Tontattas are in full revolt, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Senor Pink.

videos.title: Trump Card
videos.overview: Gladius' exploding spheres send Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling directly into Luffy and co.’s battle with some creepy dolls. Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, and Sabo tastes Fujitora's full might!

videos.title: Secret Plan
videos.overview: Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo. However, Sugar stands in their way, so Usopp uses Viola's clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take her out.

videos.title: The Operation Fruit
videos.overview: All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; however, the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and he reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora’s true intention.

videos.title: White Town
videos.overview: A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to try and kill Corazón! Law was accepted into the Doflamingo Family, but Corazón's mysterious silence hid a fact that just may have saved Law's life.

videos.title: The Island of Fate: Minion
videos.overview: Things grew stranger for Law when he learned the secret behind why Corazón feigned being mute. But the mysterious Corazón’s actions were only beginning to baffle Law when he took him on a journey to cure the youth’s disease.

videos.title: Cora
videos.overview: Corazón had finally obtained the Op Op Fruit! Doflamingo and his Family were zeroing in on Corazón and Law's whereabouts, so Corazón hid Law long enough to let him escape, even at the risk of his own life.

videos.title: Bellamy the Pirate
videos.overview: Luffy continues to fight the Doflamingo doppelganger but keeps accidentally attacking Bellamy instead. Meanwhile, the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface, and Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.

videos.title: The Spear of Elbaph and Don Sai
videos.overview: Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns within him to pay back the favor he owes! Lao G and Don Chinjao bring their most devastating attacks to bear, but a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chinjao distracted.

videos.title: Cabbage and Lomeo
videos.overview: A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield! While it appears to help Bartolomeo and co. at first, it soon sets its sights on Robin! As he continues to battle Gladius, Bartolomeo is faced with an impossible dilemma.

videos.title: To Russian, with Love
videos.overview: Senor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both are pushed to their limits, Senor Pink's tragic past is revealed! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry's rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!

videos.title: Zoro vs. Pica
videos.overview: Pica loses his temper and becomes a terrible and true force of nature. With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica's near-unstoppable onslaught.

videos.title: The Curse of Heart
videos.overview: The Tontattas finish demolishing the SMILE Factory and taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law's lifeless body! Meanwhile, the birdcage draws ever tighter around Dressrosa.

videos.title: In My Way
videos.overview: Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo's game. Meanwhile, neither Gear Second nor Gear Third attacks are working against Doflamingo, so Luffy decides to use something stronger!

videos.title: Gear Fourth
videos.overview: The birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa, so Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country. Meanwhile, Luffy digs deep into his training to provide an answer born of rubber and haki to combat Doflamingo’s might.

videos.title: Gatz
videos.overview: Using Boundman drains Luffy of his haki, leaving him in need of a rest. Luckily, the colosseum combatants run interference while he recharges, and Sabo steps in at a crucial moment to defend his brother.

videos.title: Heaven and Earth
videos.overview: With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts toward slowing the birdcage. Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, advances to attack Viola, and a hero’s recovery cannot come soon enough!

videos.title: Prostration
videos.overview: The people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy as they remember the hardships endured and the actions taken to free them. As they beg King Riku to resume the crown, Admiral Fujitora shocks onlookers with an unexpected display of humility.

videos.title: Sabo's Adventure
videos.overview: The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army and how he reunited with his brother Luffy at the colosseum.

videos.title: Soldier's Conviction
videos.overview: Major players in the Marines arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats, and Rebecca's history is whitewashed with a cover story. Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port, but not before finishing up a piece of business.

videos.title: Father and Sons
videos.overview: Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazón and the secret of Trafalgar Law's name. Luffy and the others finally make their break from the island; however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story of the Straw Hat Pirates!
